name: Jinn AI
author: Jinn AI

sections.description:
Jinn AI is an AI-powered WooCommerce plugin that enhances product discovery, highlights trending items, and optimizes upselling to increase conversions.

🚀 Boost Sales & Conversions with Jinn AI!
The Jinn AI WooCommerce Plugin leverages AI-powered insights to enhance product discovery, highlight trending items, and optimize upselling—helping you increase conversions and average order value effortlessly.

Key Features

🔥 Highlight Trending Products – Showcase your best-selling and most popular items automatically, making it easier for customers to find what’s hot.
🔍 Simplify Product Discovery – Reduce browsing time with AI-driven recommendations, ensuring customers quickly find what they need.
💰 Close More Sales – Gain valuable insights into customer preferences and adapt your offerings to match their needs.
📈 Smart Upselling – Suggest the best alternatives and deals tailored to each shopper, increasing order value and satisfaction.

🚀 Get More Conversions with Jinn AI:
– Up to 150% Higher Conversion Rates
– Up to 40% Increase in Average Order Value
– Up to 3X More Add-to-Cart Actions

Transform your WordPress store with Jinn AI and maximize your revenue!

License

This plugin is released under the GPLv3 or later license. For more information, visit GPL v3.
sections.installation:
Installation Steps for Jinn AI from WordPress Marketplace

Follow these steps to install and set up the Jinn AI plugin on your WordPress store:

Step 1: Access WordPress Marketplace

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. In the search bar, type Jinn AI and press Enter.

Step 2: Install the Jinn AI Plugin

  1. Locate the Jinn AI plugin in the search results.
  2. Click Install Now and wait for the installation to complete.
  3. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin on your store.

Step 3: Connect Jinn AI to Your Store

  1. After activation, go to Jinn AI in the WordPress dashboard sidebar.
  2. Log in for a Jinn AI account if prompted.

Step 4: Configure AI-Powered Recommendations

  1. Browse and Manage Products – Easily add new products and use tags to improve AI-driven recommendations.
  2. Preview & Test Jinn AI – Adjust its functionality and appearance to ensure seamless customer interactions.
  3. Optimize Discounts – View, manage, and apply AI-powered discount strategies to boost sales.
  4. Enhance Jinn Knowledge Base – Upload contextual documents to refine responses and improve customer engagement.
  5. Save settings and test AI recommendations on your store to ensure everything works smoothly.

🎉 You’re all set! Your AI-powered shopping assistant is now live, enhancing product discovery, smart upsells, and customer engagement.
sections.faq:
How can Jinn AI benefit my online business?

Jinn AI enhances online engagement through AI-driven interactions. With our Jinn AI assistant, lead-generating chatbots, and real-time live chat, we help convert visitors into customers.

How can you integrate Jinn AI with your website?

If your website is built on WordPress, Shopify, or other popular platforms, integration is quick and easy. Simply install our plugin and log into your Jinn AI account within the plugin settings—everything is handled automatically.

How to integrate the Jinn AI assistant into your website?

No coding skills? No problem! The Jinn AI assistant is a plug-and-play solution designed for effortless integration. It takes less than 5 minutes to set up. The AI learns from your website content, product feed, or uploaded documents, allowing it to provide personalized shopping guidance and recommendations to your visitors.

How can I train Jinn AI to understand my content?

You can enhance Jinn AI’s accuracy by:
– Uploading FAQs – Add your frequently asked questions to the platform.
– Providing Documents – Upload relevant PDFs or text files.

Can you show me how the chatbot works?

Of course! Visit our website to interact with the Jinn AI assistant in real-time. For a deeper understanding, check out our detailed demo here.

Where can I find more detailed information about specific features?

You can connect with our Co-founder by booking a call at Apollo. Alternatively, feel free to reach out to us at help@jinn.live—we’re happy to assist!

Is my data secure on Jinn AI?

We take data privacy seriously. Jinn AI uses encryption and secure protocols to protect user information. For more details, check our Privacy Policy.

Can I delete my account and data?

Yes, you can request account deletion by writing to us at help@jinn.live.

How does Jinn AI handle user privacy?

Jinn AI follows strict privacy guidelines. We do not sell or share your data without consent. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

Does Jinn AI offer customer support?

Yes! Our support team is available during business hours to assist you with any questions or issues.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the chatbot script loads asynchronously to ensure minimal impact on website performance.
